title: Legacy of the First Sun
description: A first-person sci-fi survival horror set on Nyx-65, a forbidden biological experiment left to evolve on its own. As a stranded space scavenger, you must occupy abandoned infrastructures, manage scarce resources, and survive within a living ecosystem that adapts to every intrusion. The planet does not hunt you — it simply responds.
features: Systemic survival focused on infrastructure occupation and maintenance
Living ecosystem with territorial, opportunistic and adaptive organisms
Scarce, improvised combat where every encounter carries risk
Environmental storytelling through abandoned facilities and biological remnants
Progression through practical learning and camp-based upgrades, not abstract XP
